subject: info-intr
title: INFO.INTR.------TR.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-24, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the sophistication of the western defining and controlling community has helped to produce a situation where the transfer-shift implications (interpretations) of black creativity have assumed more importance than the principle thrust projection responsible for the subsequent transfers (the leaf is more important than the tree).' (C)INFO-INTR (information interpretation) is crossed with TR (transformation). The diagram poses what *information interpretation* — Braxton's term for how the meaning of an event gets fixed — would have to look like to actually deliver transformation rather than merely re-encoding meaning. INFO-INTR is fed by CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions), INT (intention), and C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude). INFO-INTR outputs to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), C-CONT (composite continuance) → LK-IMP (linkage implications), TR (the crossing partner), and LANG-DY (language dynamics) → MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). The structural argument: information interpretation's path to transformation runs through dynamic functionalism, composite continuance, and language dynamics — and it requires *all three* upstream feeds (cross-transfer definitions, intention, and culture attitude) to generate. The 'leaf vs tree' problem is now visible: when interpretation gets dominated by cross-transfer definitions alone, the tripartite upstream collapses and transformation cannot follow.
